Change has been successfully rebased and submitted as 785c24fdabada031996630cdd4f67c85fa89d65f

This flow will log 2 PELs if collection fails for both primary and secondary.
The ask is to get this covered using only one PEL. Logging PEL is an expensive operation.
Acknowledged. made the changes.
Catch block can be more optimized.
Done
When both primary and secondary is failing then the flow is logging two PELs in the same flow that should be optimized
Updated

Why are we throwing in case there is not redundant eeprom path? Is it mandatory to have that?
This will not fail the complete process of performing initial set up?

If no REDUNDANT_SYSTEM_VPD_FILE_PATH is defined, this API throws the exception to the caller, which matches the current behavior.
System VPD collection is mandatory since the IM value cannot be identified without reading the system VPD; hence, further operations cannot be performed and the exception is propagated back to the caller.
Acknowledged
We can optimize it further, please check.
Done
What is the requirement of having nested try/catch?
Updated the code.
Add a period at the end. In case both primary and redundant fails, The same message will be logged twice. In that case it will be more readable.
Done
This needs to be logged outside catch else it will be lost if we take a reboot in case of genesis boot.
Done
Redundant can fail post this point as well. Then we end up logging two PELs again. Can that be fixed?
As discussed, added todo to handle this scenario .
Acknowledged
